title: Type the mark_scene tool result instead of structural casting
description: Tech-debt review finding. orchestrator.ts isClosedSceneResult inspects the mark_scene result via a hand-written cast of ToolResult.data with no compile-time link to what markSceneTool.run returns. A shape change silently stops scenes being summarized. Export a typed mark_scene result shape or detect closed scenes from typed call args. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
close_reason: Typed mark_scene result data via MarkSceneToolData, linked markSceneTool returns with satisfies, and replaced orchestrator structural cast with isMarkSceneToolData.
